ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened sharply lower, with BTC down 4.3% and ETH down 6.4% as the Senate rejected the Clarity Act, triggering broad sell‑offs across major coins and crypto‑related stocks. The downturn is compounded by bearish macro cues from Fed rate‑hike expectations and a new BIS report highlighting gaps in on‑chain transfer data.
